get_day.description: Look up today, tomorrow, yesterday or any date since 1970 in the Catholic liturgical calendar: the season and week, what is celebrated, its rank and the liturgical colour, plus any optional memorials. Today is worked out on Central European time, the calendar service's clock; pick a specific date to be exact about it.

get_lectionary_cycle.description: Find which cycle of Mass readings is in use on a date: Year A, B or C for Sundays and Year I or II for weekdays. The liturgical year starts on the first Sunday of Advent, so a date in December can fall in the next year's cycle; this works that out and returns the year's first and last day.

mock_response.summary: Sunday readings: Year A. Weekday readings: Year II.

sunday_cycle.description: The Sunday readings' cycle: A, B or C.

weekday_cycle.description: The weekday readings' cycle: I or II.

description: Look up the Roman Catholic liturgical calendar from a workflow: what is celebrated today or on any date since 1970, the season, the rank and the liturgical colour, a whole month's feasts at once, and which cycle of readings is in use. Covers the General Roman Calendar in English, Latin, French and Italian, and the Czech national and diocesan calendars.
